summary_en: Daisan updated its capital-cost and share-price conscious management framework on 25 June 2026. Specific targets and metrics not disclosed in the press release header; full policy details in attached materials.
title_en: Response toward realizing management conscious of capital cost and share price (Update)
translation_en_brief: On 25 June 2026, Daisan's board of directors approved an update to its framework for management conscious of capital cost and share price. The company analysed its current position and revised its approach going forward. Specific metrics, targets, horizons and payout-ratio floors are detailed in the attached materials, which were not provided in the press-release header text. This is a formal COC policy update by the company.
